definitions.explanation: To work out a number or result, especially using a calculator or abacus.

definitions.gloss: to push out; to force out
definitions.explanation: To expel or exclude someone or something.

examples.english: When I calculated the budget, it was higher than I thought.

examples.english: Domestic manufacturers are struggling, pushed out by cheap imports.

notes:
A compound verb: ⟦{弾|はじ}く→弾く：10886_hajiku⟧ (to flick, to repel) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out). The two senses come from the two readings of that flick — flicking beads to produce a figure, or flicking something away so it ends up outside.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Sense 1 takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the figure produced: ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す
- Sense 2 takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the one expelled and ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ for the place they are expelled from

ETYMOLOGY:
The calculating sense comes from the ⟦{算盤|そろばん}→算盤：04400_soroban⟧ (abacus), whose beads are flicked to produce a result. It still suggests working a figure out rather than merely reading it off, so it fits estimates and projections better than simple arithmetic.

SENSE 2 (exclusion):
Sense 2 is most often passive — {弾|はじ}き{出|だ}される — because the interesting party is the one pushed out, not whoever did the pushing. It is stronger and more impersonal than simply being left out: a market or a group squeezes the person or company out.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す (to work out figures)
- ⟦{見積|みつも}り→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}す (to calculate an estimate)
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{弾|はじ}き{出|だ}される (to be excluded from a group)
